_description: Our experiments. Each one changes some defaults from configs/config.py. Keys with '_' in start are only comments, load_experiment() skips them. Two ablation runs must be different ONLY in patch_size!

baseline_p4._description: Baseline, 4x4 patches -> 64 patch tokens, 65 with CLS.

ablation_p8._description: Ablation, 8x8 patches -> 16 patch tokens, 17 with CLS. All other things same like baseline.

smoke._description: Very small run on CPU with fake data, for tests and `python main.py smoke`. Should finish in less than 1 minute.
